title: Add Docker Compose base services

context.summary: Create Docker Compose base services for Postgres, Redis, API, MCP and worker placeholders, plus optional profile skeletons.
context.background: TASK-2 established the monorepo layout. TASK-3 makes the self-hosted deployment shape concrete without implementing product runtime behavior.

in: Create docker-compose.yml with Postgres, Redis, API placeholder, MCP placeholder and worker placeholder services.
Create docker-compose.override.yml for local development defaults.
Add optional profile skeletons for minio, clamav, qdrant, docling and ollama.
Add an explicit Docker placeholder runner for app services.
Add compose validation to repository checks.
Update deployment, configuration, architecture and README documentation.
out: Install dependencies or build production images.
Add Docker Compose scaling refinements beyond the base scaffold.

acceptance_criteria: Repository contains docker-compose.yml with postgres, redis, api, mcp and worker services.
Repository contains docker-compose.override.yml for local development defaults.
Postgres uses a pgvector-capable image and Redis uses a Redis image.
API, MCP and worker services run explicit TASK-3 placeholders rather than product runtime code.
Optional profiles exist for minio, clamav, qdrant, docling and ollama.
Compose configuration uses .env-compatible Mindory environment variables with defaults.
Documentation explains the base compose services and placeholder scope.
No API, database, worker, MCP, CLI or Hermes product behavior is implemented.

manual_checks: Confirm placeholder runtime paths are namespaced and not product endpoints.
Confirm optional profiles are present but do not force optional dependencies into the base stack.
Run docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.override.yml config in an environment with Docker CLI available.

risks: The app services are placeholders and should be replaced by real images and runtime commands in later task-scoped changes.
Running docker compose up may require network access to pull images if they are not present locally.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch can be merged into master without unrelated changes.
